'''Sun jammer racing''' was a sport that involved racing solar wind-driven vehicles called [[Sun jammer]]s. The [[Chandrilan Cometary Games]] was a popular sun-jammer racing event. The [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Janstren Brell]] and the criminal organization the "[[Red & Black League]]" once committed the exploit known as the "[[Ursellin Sun Jammer Race Fixings]]."

Annual sun-jammer races were sponsored by the [[Kendamari Casinos]] in the [[Lol sector/Legends|Lol sector]], attracting [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]] from neighboring [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] to their casinos.
